text: An object 1 in a category C is called terminal when:
choices: for every object A there is exactly one morphism A → 1
for every object A there is exactly one morphism 1 → A
it is isomorphic to every other object
explanation: A terminal object 1 receives exactly one morphism from every object A (A → 1). Option B describes the dual notion, an initial object (a unique arrow 1 → A out of it). In Set every singleton is terminal and ∅ is initial.
